channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: Magnus Carlsen claims inaugural FIDE Freestyle Chess world title
item.description: Norway's Magnus Carlsen clinched the first official FIDE Freestyle Chess world championship with a comeback victory over Fabiano Caruana in Germany.

item.title: Warner Bros mulls Paramount talks after new Netflix offer
item.description: Warner Bros Discovery is considering reopening sale talks with Paramount after receiving a new offer from Netflix, as the media merger battle intensifies.

item.title: Ambulance delay in Jelapang crash due to wrong location
item.description: The Perak State Health Department says an ambulance was delayed reaching a fatal crash in Jelapang because the initial emergency call gave an incorrect location eight kilometres away

item.title: Speedy Tigers target World Cup final spot in Egypt qualifiers
item.description: Malaysia's national hockey team aims for World Cup qualification by reaching the final in Egypt, with preparations focused on defence and managing Ramadan challenges

item.title: Skilled professionals urged to join Territorial Army for national defence
item.description: Defence Minister calls on experts from oil and gas, medical, IT and geo-spatial sectors to join reserves, aiming for a one-to-one ratio with regular forces by 2033

item.title: Police seize RM8.8 million in vape devices and liquid nationwide
item.description: Malaysian police confiscated vape products worth RM8.876 million in a nationwide raid, arresting four individuals and inspecting 154 locations

item.title: Accused Bondi killer appears in court via video link
item.description: Accused mass shooter Naveed Akram appears in court via video link as Australia grapples with the aftermath of the nation's worst mass shooting in decades

item.title: Agong: No one, not even MACC, immune to graft scrutiny
item.description: Sultan Ibrahim warns all agencies, including MACC, are under radar in anti-corruption drive

item.title: Australian museum recovers stolen Egyptian artefacts after break-in
item.description: Australian police recover stolen Egyptian treasures and charge a man after a museum break-in, with most items found undamaged.

item.title: MCBA seizes 2.09 tonnes of produce at Rantau Panjang
item.description: Border agency foils attempt to import Thai produce without permits, haul worth RM96,068 this year.
